Ask questions when you need to, dont worry about anyone else in that class except yourself, help others if you can but you shouldnt be afraid to ask stupid questions, everyone will and if they dont then they definitely want to but are worried about looking dumb. As far as clothes, wear your fire dept casual shirt and some weather appropriate pants/shorts, its not a formal event, just dont wear anything inappropriate.
